PRESS KIT


Bio | Quotes & Press | Music/Video | Photos | Contact |

GLITCHLETTE creates neuroplastic pop: uncategorizable, challenging & emotionally devastating music for people who experience heartbreak as horror. Post-genre synaptic update required.

GLITCHLETTE is a genre-blurring artist based in the Pacific Northwest. Rooted in pop sensibilities but shaped by progressive metal, trip hop, IDM, and ambient, she crafts emotionally provocative tracks that refuse easy categorization, a sound she calls "neuroplastic pop."

After debuting with the 2018 EP SUBSOIL, she collaborated with Default Genders in 2020. In September 2025, GLITCHLETTE will showcase the evolution of her sound in her sophomore EP: EVERY RAT WANTS TO CRAWL IN YOUR MOUTH AND CLEAN YOUR TEETH, an exploration of heartbreak visually expressed through the lens of psychological horror. Each track functions as emotional ritual, exorcising catharsis from obsession through cinematic and irregular song structures. Think tension and release, tonal shifts and left-turn plot twists.
